messages:
maya: paging — seeing a p99 latency surge on chat/completions across multiple regions, started ~1838204400. API error rate ok, but tail is awful. Customers A+B reported slow responses. @incident-bot any extra context?

incident-bot: ALERT triggered: HighLatency.ChatCompletions.p99 at 2026-03-15T14:02:47Z. Current p99=1.9s (hosted-us-east-1), threshold=750ms. Top-affected models: xlarge-v1, mistral-13b. Route list: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions.

ravi: i'm on it — looking at route split and model affinity. initial hypothesis: sudden traffic skew to xlarge-v1 causing KV cache thrash + longer compile paths.

sam (sre): grabbing logs now. if it's KV cache thrash we should see high GPU memory churn and cache misses in runtime metrics. sam: also seeing increased queueing in the serving runtime (latency spike correlation with qDepth > 200).

olivia (prodeng): are we routing everything to the same dedicated pool? could be a bad placement after autoscaler flapped.

maya: @ravi can we temporarily split routing so chat-completions for low-priority customers go to smaller models/compat fallback? need mitigation ASAP to reduce customer impact.

ravi: yes, can push a temporary routing override: send 20% of non-enterprise traffic to small-v1 and enable model fallback for non-critical routes. doing a canary now.

ravi: canary looks stable for small-v1. p99 down from 1.9s -> ~980ms for overall traffic in the canary region.

maya: nice. paging update: 1) mitigation = routing override (20% fallback) 2) autoscaler adjustment to avoid simultaneous pod restarts 3) schedule post-incident tune.

jules (pm): quick customer impact note: two mid-market customers saw request latencies > 3s for ~12 minutes, one observed some timed-out callbacks. We should include a coordinated customer note.

sam (sre): root-cause still being investigated. but we need to fix alert noise and thresholds — current p99 threshold (750ms) was too brittle for multi-model traffic mix. Suggest short-term: squelch p99 alert for chat/completions for 15m while we stabilize, and adjust thresholds to be per-model-group.

olivia (prodeng): agree on per-model-group. Proposal: create 3 model groups with different alert bands: small (low-latency) p95=300ms p99=700ms; medium p95=450ms p99=1100ms; large-context p95=850ms p99=1800ms. This maps to token cost/latency profiles.

maya: +1. also want per-route granularity — short chat routes vs long streaming completions behave differently. We should split /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions in alerts.

ravi: prototyping a PromQL expression to drive per-model-group p99 alerts. dropping here as a paste:

```
# per-model-group p99 over 5m rolling window
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/(chat/completions|completions)",model_group=~"(small|medium|large)"}[5m])) by (le, model_group))
```

sam (sre): that looks fine. operational notes: use 5m window + require sustained breach for 2 consecutive 1m evaluation windows before paging. That reduces flapping. Also add a smoothing transform (exponential moving average) in the alert pipeline so momentary GC spikes don't page.

jules (pm): for the follow-up we need: 1) new alert doc with per-model-group thresholds, 2) dashboards for model_group x route x region 3) runbook section for routing override and autoscaler guardrails. Assign owners pls.

maya: owners: ravi = routing override + playbook update; sam = alert rule change + smoothing; olivia = dashboard panels + perf scorecard; jules = customer comm + postmortem. I'll create a short incident ticket now.

maya: creating ticket: `INC-2026-0423` — brief: p99 latency surge chat/completions; mitigation: routing override fallback; next steps: alert threshold refactor, dashboards, runbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0423 (placeholder).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created and assigned. On-call: maya. Pager rotation unchanged.

ravi: proposed immediate threshold delta (short term): for /v1/chat/completions p99 -> raise to 1.2s for large-group only, p95 stays tighter. We'll tune with 24h rolling data.

sam (sre): implementable plan: 1) update alert expressions to include `model_group` label 2) set `for: 2m` and `evaluation_interval: 1m` 3) add `suppression_window: 15m` when a mitigation tag is active (routing-override). Sample alert YAML snippet: 

```
- alert: ChatCompletionsHighP99
  expr: |-
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions",model_group="large"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.2
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 > 1.2s for large models on chat/completions"
```

maya: please coordinate with eng-sre to roll this change to prod during quiet hours if possible. We should avoid making alerting changes during a live incident unless it's a short squelch.

olivia (prodeng): i'll sketch the dashboard panels: heatmap of p99 by model_group x region, time-series for queue depth, and a table of top 10 routes by p99. Will add links to evaluation prompts so we can detect quality regressions when we change models.

jules (pm): tentative timeline: implement alert changes and dashboards within 48 hours, postmortem in 72 hours, and a longer-term RFC for adaptive thresholds (based on model cost & 7d rolling percentiles) in 2 weeks.

maya: thanks all. current status: mitigation in place, customer impact limited, working on durable alerting fix. I'll update the incident ticket with these notes and flag follow-ups.

ravi: one more note — consider adding a `route_weight` signal to metrics so we can compute weighted percentiles by traffic source in future.

sam (sre): agreed. leaving a final action: create an ops task to backfill 30 days of per-model p95/p99 baselines for threshold calibration. Assigned to sam.

maya: signing off from pager for now — handing to afternoon oncall at 1838205000. Handoff done, leaving notes in INC ticket. :white_check_mark:
